expected_symptom: See expected.md: DxbcConverter's ArrayRef<float> reinterpret of integer ICB data + BitcodeWriter's getElementAsFloat() round-trip silently corrupts a bit-22 signalling-NaN pattern on x86 (0xffbfffca -> 0xffffffca), verifiable at the source level and by isolated ABI mechanism reproduction; not executable end-to-end via dxc.exe in this environment.
godbolt_skip: DxbcConverter (the legacy DXBC-to-DXIL converter this bug lives in) is never invoked by any CE dxc pane, which compiles HLSL directly through the same unaffected front-end path as local dxc.exe; a clean CE link would show correct output and misleadingly read as 'fixed'. See notes.md control-direct-hlsl.hlsl / variant-direct-hlsl-main-debug.txt for the equivalent local evidence.
history: Regression, not a standing bug. Source read via git show <tag>:path at each stable release tag (git show/git log, not dxc.exe execution, since dxc.exe never reaches DxbcConverter): buggy (ArrayRef<float>) v1.5.2003 through v1.7.2207; FIXED (ArrayRef<uint32_t>) at v1.7.2212 and v1.7.2212.1 via PR 4790 / commit 0a1f7a19f (merged 2022-11-23); reverted and buggy again from v1.7.2308 (2023-08-14) onward via PR 5253 (release branch) and PR 5279 (main, merged 2023-06-08) through the current latest stable v1.9.2607 (2026-07-29) and at main-debug ground truth. v1.4.1907 is an invalid probe: projects/dxilconv did not exist yet (added 2020-02-11, commit a42ffbf49), confirmed via git show failing with 'path exists on disk, but not in v1.4.1907'. No prereleases were needed or probed.
regressed_in: v1.7.2308 (PR 5253 on release branch, PR 5279 on main, reverting PR 4790)
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: DxbcConverter still reinterprets integer ICB data as float (DxbcConverter.cpp) and BitcodeWriter still round-trips it through getElementAsFloat(), unchanged at main-debug (89e2f98e2). PR 4790 fixed this (shipped v1.7.2212-v1.7.2212.1); PR 5253/5279 reverted it on main (merged 2023-06-08) 'to be re-evaluated once AMD root-causes the issue' and no re-fix has landed since -- every stable release v1.7.2308 through v1.9.2607 (latest) is broken again, matching main-debug. dxc.exe cannot exercise this directly (DxbcConverter is only reached via the D3D12 runtime or a standalone dxbc2dxil, dxilconv is not built in this checkout, and no cached release ships dxbc2dxil), so verification is source-level (git show across 21 release tags) plus a standalone x86-vs-x64 ABI harness that reproduces the issue's exact reported bit corruption (0xffbfffca to 0xffffffca) on x86 and shows it absent on x64, with positive and negative controls.
title: `DxbcConverter` can corrupt integer Immediate Constant Buffer values (x86)
